description: The file 'lan.php' is a PHP source file that serves as a web page for displaying and managing LAN Ethernet port information on a network gateway device. It includes PHP code for retrieving network port status, configurations, and partner-specific options, as well as embedded JavaScript for UI interactions like saving port configurations and triggering reboots.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if Ethernet Port 4 is enabled for XFINITY HOME or HOME SECURITY network connection by checking specific port configurations.

methods.name: onsavePort4
methods.description: Handles saving the Ethernet Port 4 configuration, sending an AJAX request to update the hardware, and providing user feedback.

methods.name: initEvents
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for UI elements such as buttons to trigger save actions.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Triggers a router reboot via AJAX and waits for reconnection, used after changing network configurations.
